16. 圖中，扇形 $OAB$ 及扇形 $OCD$ 的圓心均為 $O$。若 $\widehat{AB} = 12\pi\text{ cm}、\widehat{CD} = 16\pi\text{ cm}$ 及 $OA = 30\text{ cm}，則 AC = $

A. $5\text{ cm}。$
B. $10\text{ cm}。$
C. $20\text{ cm}。$
D. $40\text{ cm}。$
reasoning: Let $\theta$ be the central angle in radians. The arc length formula is $s = r\theta$. For arc $AB$: $12\pi = 30\theta \Rightarrow \theta = \frac{12\pi}{30} = \frac{2\pi}{5}$. For arc $CD$: $16\pi = OC \cdot \theta = OC \cdot \frac{2\pi}{5}$. Solving for $OC$, we get $OC = 16\pi \cdot \frac{5}{2\pi} = 40\text{ cm}$. Since $AC = OC - OA$, then $AC = 40 - 30 = 10\text{ cm}$.
